title: DualTPA
description: A simple but powerful teleport request plugin that makes moving around your server easier - including the ability to invite multiple players at once.
body:
# DualTPA
Bring players together faster with DualTPA — a lightweight TPA plugin with a unique 2-player `/tpahere` feature.

## Features

**2 Player TPAHere**
- Invite up to **2 players at the same time** using `/tpahere`

**Simple TPA System**
- Send, accept, or decline teleport requests easily

**Clickable Requests**
- Accept or deny requests directly from chat

**Teleport Toggle**
- Enable or disable incoming teleport requests

**Lightweight**
- Designed to run smoothly without affecting server performance

**Permission Support**
- Control access to DualTPA commands

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/tpa <player>` | Sends a teleport request to a player |
| `/tpahere <player> & [player2]` | Requests up to 2 players to teleport to you |
| `/tpaccept` | Accepts a teleport request |
| `/tpdecline` | Declines a teleport request |
| `/tptoggle` | Toggles receiving teleport requests |
| `/tphelp` | Shows all DualTPA commands |
